prompt: Use the attached locked V9 Companion sheet as the only visual reference. Generate exactly one clean 2 rows by 4 columns source kit with eight equally spaced isolated black-and-white secondary components in this exact reading order: left cheek detail, right cheek detail, cheek dot pair, small four-point sparkle; small heart, small question mark, small exclamation mark, detached listening arcs. These are isolated V9-style source components only, on pure white background, with generous whitespace around every component. There must be no face, no eyes, no eyebrows, no mouth, no nose, no complete character and no panel labels. The left and right cheek details are only two or three short sparse outward face-edge strokes, like a subtle whisker-like decorative accent; they must not form permanent animal whiskers, cat outline, ears or a moustache. Keep the same compact black V9 line weight and rounded, friendly geometry. No text, grid lines, border, device frame, grey, gradient, shading or texture. This is a candidate component sheet for later registered masking and legal-position composition, never a face card, animation frame or runtime asset. No charging or error component.
negative_constraints: no face, no eyes, no eyebrows, no nose, no mouth and no complete character
no cat outline, ears, permanent animal whiskers, moustache or animal silhouette
no V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8, V9-extension or V10 pixels, components or visual reference
no whole-face animation claim, CEMP/PBM flipbook or runtime activation
no moon, crescent, Z, charging or error face
post_generation_gate: Machine-check the exact 2x4 isolated component vocabulary, nonblank/distinct masks, and absence of face or eye-shaped source components. Only if V9, V10 and V11 all pass may the combined source bundle reach canonical owner art review. Later use must register crop, anchor, legal offset, z-order and state role for every extracted detail mask.
